moments.title: Premier League Friday Night Football
moments.blurb: Crystal Palace host Manchester City at Selhurst Park for the first Friday night fixture of the new Premier League season.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: Friday night lights! Crystal Palace vs Manchester City kicks off the weekend's Premier League action. Who are you backing?

angles.name: City's Challenge
angles.copy: Can Man City keep up the pressure at the top? They head to Selhurst Park to face a determined Crystal Palace tonight.

moments.title: Saturday Early Kick-off: Liverpool vs Nottingham Forest
moments.blurb: Liverpool welcome Nottingham Forest to Anfield for the Saturday lunchtime Premier League fixture.

angles.name: Early Game Anticipation
angles.copy: Liverpool vs Nottingham Forest – the early Premier League kick-off on Saturday. Big points on the line at Anfield!

angles.name: Forest's Anfield Test
angles.copy: Nottingham Forest face a massive test away at Liverpool this Saturday. Can they cause an upset?

moments.title: Tottenham Hotspur host Newcastle United
moments.blurb: Tottenham Hotspur take on Newcastle United in a key Premier League clash on Saturday evening.

angles.name: Top 6 Battle
angles.copy: It's a huge one on Saturday evening! Tottenham host Newcastle in a clash that could impact the top end of the Premier League table.

angles.name: Magpies on the Road
angles.copy: Newcastle travel to North London this weekend. Can they get a result against Spurs?

moments.title: Creamfields Festival This Weekend
moments.blurb: The massive dance music festival Creamfields returns to Daresbury Estate, Cheshire, from August 27th to 29th, featuring Calvin Harris, Underworld, and Sonny Fodera.

angles.name: Creamfields Kicks Off
angles.copy: Creamfields 2026 is almost here! Who's ready for an epic weekend of dance music in Cheshire?

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Calvin Harris, Underworld, Sonny Fodera – the Creamfields lineup is stacked! Get ready for three days of non-stop beats.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals This Weekend
moments.blurb: Reading and Leeds Festivals run from August 28th to 30th, with headliners including Charli XCX, Chase & Status, Dave, and Florence And The Machine.

angles.name: Reading & Leeds Countdown
angles.copy: The biggest weekend in UK festival season is almost here! Reading & Leeds kicks off this Friday. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: Diverse Lineup
angles.copy: From Charli XCX to Florence + The Machine, Reading & Leeds has something for everyone this weekend. Let the festival begin!

moments.title: Bon Jovi Kicks Off UK Tour
moments.blurb: Rock legends Bon Jovi begin their UK tour this Friday, August 28th, with dates in London and Edinburgh through early September.

angles.name: Bon Jovi is Back
angles.copy: Get ready, UK! Bon Jovi start their highly anticipated tour this Friday. Are you going to see the rock icons?

angles.name: Living On A Prayer Live
angles.copy: Bon Jovi are bringing the hits to London and Edinburgh this week! Which classic track are you most hoping to hear?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's Chart Record
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's duet 'Rein Me In' made history in February 2026, becoming the longest-running UK number-one single of all time with 22 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Chart History Makers
angles.copy: Still buzzing about Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' making UK chart history. 22 weeks at number one! An incredible achievement.

angles.name: Rein Me In Legacy
angles.copy: It's the longest-running UK number one ever! What makes 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean such a timeless hit for you?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend Approaching
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer for many.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday weekend is just days away! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: Make the most of the August Bank Holiday! It's the perfect chance for a final summer adventure before autumn sets in.

moments.title: Glen Matlock of Sex Pistols Turns 70
moments.blurb: Glen Matlock, original bass guitarist and songwriter for the iconic punk band The Sex Pistols, celebrates his 70th birthday on Thursday, August 27th.

angles.name: Punk Legend at 70
angles.copy: Happy 70th birthday to punk rock royalty, Glen Matlock of The Sex Pistols! What's your favourite Pistols track?

angles.name: Sex Pistols Songwriter
angles.copy: From 'God Save The Queen' to 'Anarchy in the U.K.', Glen Matlock helped shape a generation. Happy birthday to the legend!

moments.title: Alex Lifeson of Rush Turns 73
moments.blurb: Alex Lifeson, the influential guitarist and co-founder of the legendary Canadian progressive rock band Rush, celebrates his 73rd birthday on Thursday, August 27th.

angles.name: Rush Guitar God
angles.copy: Sending huge birthday wishes to the incredible Alex Lifeson of Rush, turning 73 on Thursday! What's your favourite Rush riff?

angles.name: Progressive Rock Icon
angles.copy: From 'Tom Sawyer' to 'Limelight', Alex Lifeson's guitar work is legendary. Happy birthday to a true rock pioneer!

moments.title: Shania Twain Turns 61
moments.blurb: The best-selling female artist in country music history, Shania Twain, celebrates her 61st birthday on Friday, August 28th.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Shania Twain! From 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' to 'That Don't Impress Me Much', she's a legend.

angles.name: Still the One
angles.copy: Shania Twain turns 61 on Friday! What's your ultimate Shania anthem?

moments.title: Florence Welch of Florence + The Machine Turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the enigmatic frontwoman of Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on Friday, August 28th.

angles.name: Happy 40th, Florence!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 40th birthday to the incredible Florence Welch! Her voice and artistry are truly unique.

angles.name: Dog Days Are Over
angles.copy: Florence Welch turns 40 on Friday! What's your favourite Florence + The Machine song?

moments.title: Van Morrison Turns 81
moments.blurb: The legendary Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison celebrates his 81st birthday on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Van The Man at 81
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Van Morrison! From 'Brown Eyed Girl' to 'Moondance', a true musical poet.

angles.name: Timeless Tunes
angles.copy: Van Morrison celebrates his 81st on Monday. What's the Van track that always gets you?

moments.title: Debbie Gibson Turns 56
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Debbie Gibson, who had two #1 hits in her teens, celebrates her 56th birthday on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the incredible Debbie Gibson! Still shining brightly since her teen pop sensation days.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Remember 'Foolish Beat' and 'Lost In Your Eyes'? Debbie Gibson turns 56 on Bank Holiday Monday! What's your favourite of her hits?
